- [ ] Anything users see meets WCAG 2.2 AA and works in French and Arabic (right to left)
- [ ] Docs updated (guide or README, ADR if structural, `CHANGELOG.md`)
- [ ] Backlog and Jira match (status, scope, points, links)
- [ ] No secret, credential or real student data in code, logs or notebooks
